name: millkit2
summary: Eight 12x14 modules on kit 1's exact lane grid. Each is a recognisable Southern vernacular type: a log dogtrot with an open breezeway, an ochre camelback, a white two-storey I-house with a gallery porch and end chimneys, a pyramid-roofed four-room cottage, an oxblood board-and-batten boarding house, a smokehouse work yard, a pecan and bee orchard, and a brick 1920s bungalow. No wall wood or roof material repeats kit 1, so a mixed street varies. Eight 12x14 plots on the kit-1 grid: dogtrot, camelback, I-house, pyramid cottage, boarding house, work yard, pecan orchard and bee yard, 1920s bungalow. Each house has its own wall wood and roof colour, none repeating kit 1. Six trade-cut parts; 28 rooms for furnishers; chimneys use chimney(), stairs use flight(). (35 of 36 parts finished)
